# Salet

> Salet (Salet Ltd, Companies House number 16662600, London) sells property reports to home buyers and investors in England. Type any address in England and get the Basic report (£9) or the full report (£19): what every home nearby really sold for, the stamp duty you will pay, local rents, flood risk, crime, planning and schools. Every paid report carries a 30-day full refund, no questions. Salet also works as a buyer-only buying agent.

## Products and prices

- Basic report, £9: for any address in England. The street, the energy certificate, what HM Land Registry has recorded, the neighbourhood type and local rents. Upgrades to the full report for £10.
- Buyer Intelligence Report, £19: the price range recent sold prices support at this floor area, stamp duty, rent, flood, crime, planning, schools and how busy the area is. On screen, as a PDF and by email, in minutes.
- Decision Pack, £69: the full Buyer Intelligence Report plus five likely prices costed to the pound, each with stamp duty, an indicative works budget and the usual fees. Answers "how much should I offer on this house?" with the cost at each price.
- Legal Pack Review, £29: upload an auction or sale legal pack and get every hidden cost, missing search and onerous clause, with the document and page it is on.
- Auction bundle, £39: one Buyer Intelligence Report and one Legal Pack Review.
- 5 report pack, £79: five Buyer Intelligence Reports for a shortlist, £15.80 a report, used within 12 months.
- Refunds: not useful? Full refund within 30 days of paying, no reason needed.
- One payment by card. No subscription.

## Who it is for

- Home buyers in England about to make an offer who want to know if the house is overpriced, what similar homes sold for, and what stamp duty they will pay.
- Property investors checking sold prices, rents, yield, HMO rules and auction legal packs before they buy.
- Buyers who want someone to search, negotiate and manage the purchase for them (buyer-only buying agent service).

## What the reports are not

- Not a RICS valuation or a survey: nobody visits the property.
- Not legal advice: a solicitor should review any legal pack before exchange.
- Sources: HM Land Registry price paid data, the EPC register, ONS, the Environment Agency and local planning records. Every figure is dated and sourced.

- [Local housing market by postcode district](https://salet.uk/area/): about 2,000 pages, one per postcode district in England, showing whether more homes are coming to market than usual, updated monthly. Example: https://salet.uk/area/al1/
